prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1280; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with a recent collision in which a vehicle sideswiped our client while changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full policy limits for bodily injury and property damage coverage under the policy held by the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits. Please also confirm the identity of the claims adjuster assigned to this file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, recorded statements, telematics or dashcam data, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any other materials in your possession or control. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these records.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
